title: Pragmatics Meets Culture: Culturally-adapted Artwork Description Generation and Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring comprehension of cultural symbols in artwork using multiple-choice question-answering (QA) tasks, evaluating how well model-generated descriptions help simulated listeners (LLMs) and human users from specific cultural backgrounds (American and Chinese) correctly answer culturally-attuned versus culturally-agnostic questions.
